description: TXN-LOCAL, in-process lockers (two Workspaces, one process), every commit/rollback order with the far rows 1 and 64 updated through the UNINDEXED field V (the first card's far-row phases used the indexed N and conflicted on the IX_N leaf). Per phase both Workspaces BeginTrans, A updates V of row 1 and B updates V of row 64 (Errors before/after), they resolve in the stated order (A:C A:R B:C B:R), then both rows are read. Phases: A:C then B:C, A:R then B:C, B:C then A:C, B:C then A:R, A:C then B:R, B:R then A:C. A final fresh Workspace reads after a pause and Idle. Asks whether the admitted case keeps both owners' accepted changes in every order.
